name: deploy-k8s-application
description: Deploy a Kubernetes application using Helm with validation and health checks

variables.name: appName
variables.description: Name of the application to deploy

tasks.description: Validate kubectl and helm are available

prompt.template: Check that kubectl and helm are installed and accessible. Verify kubernetes cluster connectivity by running 'kubectl cluster-info'. Report the cluster context and verify it's correct for deployment.

tasks.description: Create Kubernetes namespace if it doesn't exist

prompt.template: Create Kubernetes namespace {{namespace}} if it doesn't already exist. Use 'kubectl create namespace {{namespace}}' or verify it exists with 'kubectl get namespace {{namespace}}'.

Deploy {{appName}} using Helm chart at {{chartPath}} to namespace {{namespace}}. Use 'helm install {{appName}} {{chartPath}} --namespace {{namespace}} --create-namespace --wait --timeout=5m'. If values are provided, pass them with --set flags.

Verify that all pods for {{appName}} in namespace {{namespace}} are in Running status. Use 'kubectl get pods -n {{namespace}} -l app={{appName}}' and check that all pods show STATUS as Running. Wait up to 3 minutes for pods to become ready.

tasks.description: Perform health check on deployed application

prompt.template: Perform health check on {{appName}}. Get the service endpoint using 'kubectl get svc -n {{namespace}} {{appName}}'. If there's a /health endpoint, port-forward and test it with curl. Report the health status.
